title: Fitness AI user for a year
body:
I used Fitness AI for a year , from Oct 11 2025 to 2026 since I paid for the entire year instead of the monthly. I forced myself to workout 4-5 times a week getting up to 220 workouts for the year. This app is great it tailors your workouts for you, and once you get to a certain rep amount it increases the weight. I love this app because it takes out the guessing game of what you are going to do at the gym. 

With that being said, I see the results and as well as everyone around me. I feel much better and I have a ton more confidence and energy. 

Cons: I used this app for an entire year no breaks and there was not much change or upgrades to the workouts and or equipment. I had to substitute a lot of workouts with available workouts on the app because there was nothing similar to the machine or exercise. I wish there was a way to request certain workouts that are not on the app. Additionally, substituting workouts with the “view alternates” option only give you a few workouts. I always found it easier to delete and find what I need in the add workout. I will not be signing back up this year because I found another app that has a more advanced interface like nutritional tracking and weight tracking. But if this app invests in improving the user interface I would not second-guess signing up again next year. 

Thank you fitness AI for helping me through my year-long fitness journey.

title: Stop asking for money and signing me up before you give me a free trial
body:
I cannot trust an app without getting a demo. Plus, the question asked are not really unique - what is important to you, what parts do you want to focus, weight, height, goal weight! These are all very generic questions that almost free apps do already ask, and therefore not helpful. Yes, I do weigh 210 lbs at 5’11’’, but I have a lot of muscle.
Claiming this to be an AI fitness app, I’d expect some more intelligent/informative questions. And show me what the product is like before making me pay for a plan that I have no info on! Gemini, Claude, GPT-5 can do this stuff for free.

title: No unsubscribe button
body: I downloaded Fitness AI to compare it to the paid tiers of Fitbod and Hevy, and decided not to proceed with this app because it’s not differentiating enough from the others for the higher subscription fee, and I was turned off by the ad integration with the app. I signed up for the free trial, but there is no option in the app to unsubscribe. There is a “Delete my account” option, which I used, but it isn’t clear whether I will be charged when the free trial ends. This app does not appear in my Apple account Subscriptions list, and I only see it as a free “Purchase” in my Purchase History. There appears to be no option for me to confirm that I will not be charged by Fitness AI or Apple after the free trial ends, which helps me understand other reviewers’ frustration on this topic. The app developer should stop deflecting frustrated users to Apple when the developer is also responsible for this uncertainty on how to unsubscribe, and should inform their users on how to avoid subscription fees after the free trial ends.

title: Pretty Good, Some Improvements Needed
body:
Other people have already said what is great about the app, so here is what needs improvement:

- Assisted pull ups and dips, according to the algorithm, get harder with more weight. If you do it successfully at 50 pounds, it bumps you to 55 instead of 45. The opposite should happen…

- May not be possible, but should absolutely be useable without Wi-Fi… This would improve QOL by an order of magnitude. 

- It should say whether you should max out a specific set in the training plan (not that important but would be cool) 

- Some exercises, like negative pull ups, are missing.  

-Not sure if this is already a feature, but you should be able to favorite exercises you like so the algorithm recommends them more often 


- Paid subscriber for 6 months

The options do lack some very basic exercises or machines and you can’t manually add. I would also like to make notes on the workout - how I felt or what I would like to do differently.  I will not be renewing my subscription.
